summary.text: NORD STUDENTSAMSKIPNAD is an annet foretak iflg. særskilt lov registered in Bodø, founded 1989-01-01. NORD STUDENTSAMSKIPNAD takes care of interests related to students' welfare needs. It is a student welfare organisation for students at Nord University and the Police University College, Bodø branch. It was previously named STUDENTSAMSKIPNADEN I NORDLAND until 2016-03-03. Its main industry code is 94.992: other activities of other membership organisations. The register shows 90 employees and 13 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 203 906 606 NOK and the annual result was 3 362 384 NOK; operating income was up from 176 160 542 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -25 394 006 NOK in 2024 to 3 362 384 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 144 166 812 NOK in 2024 to 147 529 196 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is studentinord.no. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The registered employee count went from 104 on 2025-11-13 to 90 on 2026-10-14.
